items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I began taking trumpet lessons at Teacher's College by a guy named Harvey Sartorius

ctx.x: I guess so, looking back at it.

At that time I guess it must have been late grammar school and I began taking trumpet lessons at Teacher's College by a guy named Harvey Sartorius who became a music teacher on Long Island somewhere. Somebody must remember him, Harvey was quite a guy. He introduced me to a lot of these
people so that I could sit in. That was all trumpet.
